content: Linear API rate limits: API key 2500 req/hr and 3,000,000 complexity pts/hr per user; OAuth 5000 req/hr and 2,000,000 pts/hr; unauthenticated 600 req/hr per IP. Max single-query complexity 10,000 pts (hard ceiling). Headers: X-RateLimit-Requests-{Limit,Remaining,Reset}, X-RateLimit-Endpoint-Requests-*, X-RateLimit-Endpoint-Name, X-Complexity, X-RateLimit-Complexity-{Limit,Remaining,Reset}. Reset is UTC epoch ms. Over-limit returns HTTP 400 with errors[].extensions.code = RATELIMITED (not 429). Complexity: 0.1/property, 1/object, connections multiply children by pagination arg or default 50.
